c01.text: Breast cancer that is HER2 negative with 1 or more positive lymph nodes.

c02.text: Breast cancer that is ER positive and PR negative.

c03.text: Triple-negative breast cancer (ER negative, PR negative and HER2 negative).

c04.text: Breast cancer with lymphovascular invasion present and a tumor larger than 20 mm.

c05.text: Breast cancer with negative margins, but the invasive carcinoma is within 3 mm of the closest margin.

c06.text: Multifocal breast cancer in a patient under 60.

c07.text: Breast cancer, Nottingham grade 3, with no lymphovascular invasion.

c08.text: Colon cancer with positive lymph nodes (stage III).

c10.text: Colon cancer with tumor deposits present.

c11.text: Colon cancer with no positive lymph nodes and lymphovascular invasion present.

c12.text: Colon cancer that penetrates the visceral peritoneum or invades adjacent structures (pT4).

c13.text: Colon cancer of 5 cm or larger with no perineural invasion.

c14.text: Lung cancer with visceral pleural invasion.

c15.text: Squamous cell carcinoma of the lung with an involved bronchial margin.

c16.text: Lung adenocarcinoma with 1 or more positive lymph nodes.

c17.text: Prostate cancer with Grade Group 4 or 5.

c18.text: Prostate cancer with seminal vesicle invasion.

c19.text: Prostate cancer with a positive surgical margin and no extraprostatic extension.

c20.text: Prostate cancer with perineural invasion present and lymphovascular invasion not identified.

c21.text: Stomach cancer that is HER2 positive.

c22.text: Stomach cancer with poorly cohesive (diffuse type, not mixed) histology and 1 or more positive lymph nodes.

c23.text: Stomach cancer that penetrates the serosa or invades adjacent structures (pT4).

c24.text: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma with ISUP grade 3 or 4.

c25.text: Kidney cancer with sarcomatoid or rhabdoid features present.

c26.text: Kidney cancer that extends into the renal vein or inferior vena cava.

c27.text: Basal cell carcinoma with an involved deep margin.

c28.text: Invasive squamous cell carcinoma of the skin that is not well differentiated (grade 2 or 3).

c29.text: Patients aged 70 or older with node-positive colon cancer.

c30.text: Female patients with lung cancer reported in 2023 or 2024.
